name: SpanRef
docs:
A reference to [span data] and the associated [registry].

This type implements all the same methods as [`SpanData`], and provides
additional methods for querying the registry based on values from the span.

[registry]: LookupSpan
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: extensions
docs:
Returns a reference to this span's `Extensions`.

The extensions may be used by `Layer`s to store additional data
describing the span.
